svg.title: Proof-Preserving Graph Theory
svg.desc: Scientific map of certificates, proof-preserving graphs, BDD, Lovász Local Lemma, Moser–Tardos witness trees, the completed random-initialization expectation bound, and the MT repair bridge with a successful build confirmed by the user. Dotted links explicitly require model interpretation or core preservation.

q is the Local Lemma parameter; x is the MT resampling budget. The expected-work theorem uses finite V and finite nonempty event labels.
The constant table proves existential reachability from each state. It does not assert almost-sure termination from every fixed state.
A certified repair additionally needs certificate coverage and core preservation; route edges remain a separate condition.
The completed expectation argument is witness-tree counting. Entropy compression is a separate, unimplemented route.
